item.title: Ācta Diurna · Diēs Lūnae, V Īd. Nov. (Mon 9 Nov 2026)
item.description: Canberra 2–21° and mostly sunny, 25° tomorrow; Australia's economy slows: 4.85% cash rate, 3.6% core inflation, Angus Taylor: 'you don't punish growth', Chalmers seeks productivity ideas; Iran: US Task Force Iron Gate targets land routes, 147 ships turned back; US: Senate counts in Mississippi and Alaska, Massie moves to impeach Hegseth; Ukraine: Russia hits the power grid, talks set for Abu Dhabi; Corvo island turns off its lights for seabirds; Opīniō: Rowan Dean on progressive antisemitism and the Segal report; the Lateran Basilica dedicated, AD 324. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology via WillyWeather; The Spectator Australia (Tony Nikolic, Rowan Dean); ABC News (6 Nov); Fox News and CBS News (7–8 Nov); Yahoo News (7 Nov); Kyiv Independent (8 Nov); Good Good Good (7 Nov).

item.title: Ācta Diurna · Diēs Dominicus, VI Īd. Nov. (Sun 8 Nov 2026)
item.description: Canberra 3–21° and sunny; the RBA's fifth rate rise (4.85%, an 18-year high) and Angus Taylor: 'homegrown' inflation; US midterms: Republicans lose both houses, Stephen Miller new chief of staff, Hegseth under fire; Iran's offer via Qatar, tankers hit mines in Hormuz; Karl Bushby home after 28 years on foot; Opīniō: Judith Sloan on Labor's $560m grants; Nerva born, AD 30. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; ABC News (4 Nov); The Spectator Australia; Yahoo News (6 Nov); Times of Israel (6 Nov); ITV News (2 Nov).
